Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE JUNCTA JUVANT）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

C. I. D.
I. O. REQ
No....................................
Date..................................

February 15th 1916

Sir,
With reference to my report of 9th instant touching the
arrival at the Arsenal from Peking of two high military
officers on a secret mission, these men left for the capital
yesterday.
It is reported that two military officers named Tsu
Li Sun 朱麗生 and Kau Woong Lieu 高鳳樓 have come here from
Peking for the purpose of watching for officials, who desert
their posts and come to Shanghai. Tsu and Kau are staying
in the Arsenal and co-operating with the authorities there.
It is reported that the membership of the Loong Sau
Taung 龍松堂 and Tsching Loong Taung 青龍堂 two outlaw
societies in Pootung whose followers sympathise with the
rebels, are becoming more numerous every day. At noon
on the 13th instant a band of them went to a village
called Tsih Doon 七團 where they extorted money and food.
The local police were called, and after a fight, the
miscreants were dispersed. Two of the latter and two
of the former were wounded.
It is reported that the Arsenal Authorities have
notified the City Police that they have received information
that the rebels intend to make trouble on 17th instant
lantern festival day. In consequence of same the City
Police are instructed to take special precautions
on the day named.
It is stated in rebel circles that no rising
will be attempted in Shanghai for some time to come
and not until sufficient funds are secured to ensure
its success.
Officers and troops at the Arsenal are still
not allowed to take leave.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmmmmmstrona
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧手写批注：
Intelligence
msd. Feb 15
seen by C/S）

上海公共租界工部局。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 同心协力）
警务处，
（侦探股）

刑事侦缉处
情报官申请
编号....................................
日期..................................

1916年2月15日

先生：
关于我本月9日就两名高级军官秘密使命抵达兵工厂一事所呈之报告，上述人员已于昨日启程前往首都。
据报，两名名为朱麗生（Tsu Li Sun）和高鳳樓（Kau Woong Lieu）的军官已从北京来到此地，目的是监视那些擅离职守并来到上海的官员。朱、高二人现居于兵工厂内，并与该处当局合作。
据报，浦东地区同情叛军的两个非法社团——龍松堂（Loong Sau Taung）和青龍堂（Tsching Loong Taung）的成员人数日益增多。本月13日中午，一伙人前往一个名为七團（Tsih Doon）的村庄，在那里勒索钱财和食物。当地警察被召来，经过一番打斗后，歹徒被驱散。歹徒中有两人受伤，警察中亦有两人受伤。
据报，兵工厂当局已通知市警察局，他们收到情报称叛军意图在本月17日元宵节制造事端。因此，市警察局奉命在指定日期采取特别预防措施。
叛军方面声称，上海在短期内不会尝试发动起义，除非筹集到足够的资金以确保成功。
兵工厂的军官和士兵目前仍不准休假。

您顺从的仆人，
mmmmmmstrona
首席探长

警务处警司

（左侧手写批注：
情报
msd. 2月15日
已由警司阅）
